notes.title: New Features Await in Helion
notes.content:
Prepare for a cosmic upgrade as we unveil thrilling new features in the latest update to Helion! Your interstellar adventures are about to reach unprecedented heights with these game-changing additions:

🛠️ Custom Server Update:
Forge your own path among the stars! Introducing Custom Servers, where you have the power to tailor your gameplay experience. Want to hone your skills against bots or create the ultimate battleground for friends? Now you can, with customizable options that put you in control of the cosmic battlefield.

🔫 Weapon Viewer:
Knowledge is power. Arm yourself with information using the Weapon Viewer feature. Review weapons and their stats in detail, allowing you to fine-tune your loadout and dominate the cosmos with precision.

🔧 Turret Update:
Enhanced firepower awaits with the Turret Update! Engage foes with newfound efficiency using the revamped Turret Placement mechanic. Preview turret locations, then Left-click to place or Right-click to cancel, ensuring strategic placement on the battlefield. Turrets now boast increased durability, with 200HP to withstand the cosmic onslaught. They remain steadfast until destroyed or replaced by the skilled hands of the Engineer. Expect heightened combat dynamics as turrets deal 10 damage per second, turning the tide of battle in your favor.

🌌 How to Experience the Update:
Update your game to access these groundbreaking features and embark on a journey through the cosmos like never before. Custom Servers, Weapon Viewer, and Turret

notes.title: Introducing Vending Machines !
notes.content:
Prepare for an innovative addition to your interstellar arsenal - Vending Machines are now operational in Helion! These automated wonders are strategically placed across the cosmos, offering crucial support during your cosmic battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44669513/07549c34007c23f27d84f1f37008418b1a3b9031.png[/img]

🏥 MediVend Healing Stations: 💊
In the heat of battle, every hit counts. Replenish your health and rejuvenate your squad at the new MediVend Healing Stations. Strategically placed across maps, these machines provide a quick health boost, ensuring you stay in the fight.

🔫 AmmoMatic Reload Stations: 🚀
Running low on firepower? Fear not! The AmmoMatic Reload Stations are at your service. Refill your ammunition and gear up for the next wave of cosmic adversaries. Keep the fight alive with a fully loaded arsenal.

🌐 How to Access the Vending Machines:
Spot these lifesavers across various maps in Helion. Approach, interact, and let the Vending Machines equip you for victory. Whether you're low on health or ammo, these automated allies have your back.

notes.title: Exciting Update Incoming: Unleash the "Holdout" Mode and Revamped Training!
notes.content:
🎮 New Game Mode: Holdout 🕹️
Engage in intense battles in the all-new Holdout mode! Secure and defend a central point, strategically controlling it for a set duration. Team coordination is key - victory awaits those who can withstand the cosmic onslaught!

🔄 Reworked Training Grounds: 🤖
Sharpen your skills in the revamped Training mode. Choose any map from our cosmic arsenal and face off against advanced AI bots. Hone your tactics, perfect your aim, and become a master of the interstellar battlefield.

🌐 How to Experience the Update:
Update your game to access these thrilling additions. Whether you're conquering points in Holdout or refining your strategies in the enhanced Training mode, this update is set to redefine your Helion experience.

notes.title: Announcing the Arrival of "Helion" Early Access - Get Ready
notes.content:
Greetings, Soldiers, Engineers and Medical Officer,

We're ecstatic to reveal that the early access phase of Helion, is now! It's time to don your exosuits and dive into a galaxy of intense combat, futuristic weaponry, and cosmic showdowns.

🌌 Playable, Though a Work in Progress: The universe of Helion is taking shape, and while there's still much to be done, the game is ready for your exploration. Dive into the fray and witness the evolution of an epic combat experience.

🎮 Three Playable Maps: Traverse diverse environments across three playable maps, each offering unique challenges and strategic opportunities. These maps provide a sneak peek into the cosmic battlegrounds that await your expertise.

🛠️ Under Construction: UI Edition: Our user interface is undergoing its final polish. Expect a few rough edges as we refine the UI for a seamless and immersive gaming experience. Your insights on this aspect will be instrumental in achieving perfection.

💡 Lighting Quirks: Some areas may be bathed in cosmic darkness or caught in the glare of distant stars. We're actively addressing these lighting quirks to create an atmospheric and visually stunning gaming experience.

🌐 One Map in Blockout Phase: While two maps are primed for action, one is in the blockout phase. Brace yourself for an early look at the raw potential of a battleground yet to fully emerge from the forge of creation.

Your Mission Awaits:

🕹️ Dive Into the Action: Immerse yourself in the Helion universe. Explore the maps, test your combat prowess, and get a firsthand look at the foundation of our sci-fi masterpiece.

🔧 Provide Feedback: As pioneers in this cosmic adventure, your feedback is paramount. Report any bugs, share your thoughts on gameplay mechanics, and let us know your wishlist. Together, we'll shape Helion into an unparalleled third-person shooter experience.

🌌 Join the Helion Community: Connect with your fellow spacefaring warriors in our community Discord. Share strategies, recount your most thrilling moments, and become an integral part of the growing Helion universe.
